help: install a peer store's claude sessions into this machine's live Claude Code store - what it would write is corpus-yoga agent's status, per peer store held; the one adapter that vouches for a write into a live store

args.name: --id
args.help: uuid(8) prefix of the agent to install - identity is never guessed

args.name: --all
args.help: install every session the peer transported (pull --all from one machine)

args.name: --from
args.help: the peer store to install from - a machine name (bare token) or a directory (./dir or a path)
